Γιαγιά

Find the 7 τετράδια (notebooks) in the house. Each one asks you a word. Γιαγιά wants to feed you, so don't let her catch you.

  • Right answer: Γιαγιά stops for 2 seconds. "Μπράβο!"
  • Wrong answer: she gets a little faster. The notebook stays, so come back to it.
  • She catches you 3 times and it's dinner time. Find all 7 and run out the door.

Move with the arrow keys, WASD, the buttons, or swipe.

Τι σημαίνει; (What does it mean?)

Send missed words to Obsidian (they show up in Review on Today).
